sources.description: Continuous map of Europe and its approaches, painted by authoring/shared/painters/atlas.py from the recipe authoring/atlas-europe-01/europe.json and the region record design/maps/europe.json. Geography from the Natural Earth layers under authoring/geodata/natural-earth-50m (derived from the pinned release recorded in its SOURCE.json; download approved by the Owner on 2026-11-11). Interpreted by the author and recorded in the recipe: land cover of about 1800, ridge lines for ranges the 1:50m data does not outline, hydrography as of the period (modern reservoirs and post-1815 canals left out, the Zuiderzee restored), and minimum drawn widths for narrow straits. Relief is drawn, not surveyed: no elevation data was used. Drawn by an AI model as Python drawing code (pycairo 1.25 / cairo 1.18, Pillow 12.3, numpy 2.5); no image-generation model and no external image was used as input. No vector master: the editable source is the recipe and the painter. Rebuild with: python authoring/build.py authoring/atlas-europe-01.
